subject: LangBridge connector + LlamaSync adapter: interop validation & joint PoC plan
messages:
From: Anjali Rao <anjali@orchestrate.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LangBridge connector + LlamaSync adapter: proposed validation plan

Hi Karthik / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We talked internally at Orchestrate about the quick win here: a certified LangBridge connector to consume Redwood-hosted models + a LlamaSync adapter that ensures KV cache compatibility for long-context workloads.

To keep the rollout light and predictable, we put together a short proposed validation plan:
- Week 1: compatibility checklist (API surface, auth, streaming semantics)
- Week 2: PoC integration (example agent + sample dataset)
- Week 3: perf smoke tests (latency/throughput with 8k/32k context)
- Week 4: docs + sample app release

I've attached a draft interop-checklist.xlsx that captures the API checks we think matter. High-level asks: a 60–90 minute architecture + ops sync this week, and a 2-hour runoff workshop the following week where we run the PoC on your dedicated staging cluster.

Would you be able to join a sync Wed 21 or Thu 22? Also copying Kyle from Toolsmith — they maintain our LlamaSync runtime and will be part of the PoC.

Thanks,
Anjali Rao
Head of Integrations, Orchestrate.ai
---
Attachment: interop-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 12KB)

Subject: Fwd: LangBridge connector + LlamaSync adapter: proposed validation plan

Karthik / Alex / Naomi —

Looping you all here so we can pre-align before the Wed sync. A few notes after scanning their checklist:
- Auth: they call out both OAuth2 client creds and API key modes. We need to decide which we recommend for initial PoC (lean toward API key for speed, but confirm with security).
- Streaming semantics: they expect server-sent events style streaming with chunked tokens and 'done' sentinel. Our runtime already supports SSE; Alex, would there be any compatibility layer needed for LangBridge runtime shim?
- KV cache behavior: LlamaSync wants a deterministic KV import/export API (protobuf payload) — Naomi, can you validate we can export a compatible snapshot from our KV store?

Let's flag these three items as pre-reads for Wed. I've annotated the draft checklist with comments — attaching my annotated copy.

Marissa
